defmodule NativeSerializer do
  @moduledoc """
  High-performance serialization library using native interop via Rustler NIFs.
  Provides audit logging for all serialization/deserialization operations.
  """

  use Rustler, otp_app: :native_serializer, crate: "native_serializer"

  require Logger

  @type_registry %{
    "string" => 1,
    "integer" => 2,
    "float" => 3,
    "binary" => 4,
    "list" => 5,
    "map" => 6,
    "atom" => 7,
    "tuple" => 8
  }

  @max_depth 32
  @max_binary_size 16_777_216

  defmodule AuditLog do
    use GenServer

    def start_link(opts \\ []) do
      GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
    end

    def init(opts) do
      log_path = Keyword.get(opts, :log_path, "/var/log/serializer/audit.log")
      {:ok, fd} = File.open(log_path, [:append, :utf8])
      {:ok, %{fd: fd, counter: 0}}
    end

    def log_operation(op_type, metadata) do
      GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:log, op_type, metadata, System.monotonic_time()})
    end

    def handle_cast({:log, op_type, metadata, timestamp}, state) do
      entry = %{
        op: op_type,
        meta: metadata,
        ts: timestamp,
        seq: state.counter
      }
      IO.write(state.fd, Jason.encode!(entry) <> "\n")
      {:noreply, %{state | counter: state.counter + 1}}
    end
  end

  @doc "Serialize an Elixir term to binary format with native acceleration"
  def serialize(term, opts \\ []) do
    caller = Keyword.get(opts, :caller, "anonymous")
    AuditLog.log_operation(:serialize, %{caller: caller, term_type: typeof(term)})

    with {:ok, type_id} <- resolve_type(term),
         {:ok, encoded} <- encode_with_header(term, type_id, 0) do
      {:ok, encoded}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  @doc "Deserialize binary data back to Elixir term"
  def deserialize(binary, opts \\ []) when is_binary(binary) do
    caller = Keyword.get(opts, :caller, "anonymous")
    AuditLog.log_operation(:deserialize, %{caller: caller, size: byte_size(binary)})

    with {:ok, type_id, payload} <- extract_header(binary),
         {:ok, term} <- decode_payload(type_id, payload, 0) do
      {:ok, term}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_type(term) when is_binary(term), do: {:ok, @type_registry["binary"]}
  defp resolve_type(term) when is_integer(term), do: {:ok, @type_registry["integer"]}
  defp resolve_type(term) when is_float(term), do: {:ok, @type_registry["float"]}
  defp resolve_type(term) when is_list(term), do: {:ok, @type_registry["list"]}
  defp resolve_type(term) when is_map(term), do: {:ok, @type_registry["map"]}
  defp resolve_type(term) when is_atom(term), do: {:ok, @type_registry["atom"]}
  defp resolve_type(term) when is_tuple(term), do: {:ok, @type_registry["tuple"]}
  defp resolve_type(_), do: {:error, :unsupported_type}

  defp encode_with_header(term, type_id, depth) when depth < @max_depth do
    case native_encode(term, type_id, depth) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        header = <<0xNS::8, 0x01::8, type_id::8, byte_size(payload)::32-big>>
        {:ok, header <> payload}
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end
  defp encode_with_header(_, _, _), do: {:error, :max_depth_exceeded}

  defp extract_header(<<0xNS::8, version::8, type_id::8, size::32-big, rest::binary>>) do
    if version == 0x01 and byte_size(rest) == size do
      {:ok, type_id, rest}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_header}
    end
  end
  defp extract_header(_), do: {:error, :malformed_input}

  defp decode_payload(type_id, payload, depth) when depth < @max_depth do
    native_decode(type_id, payload, depth)
  end
  defp decode_payload(_, _, _), do: {:error, :max_depth_exceeded}

  # NIF stubs - replaced at load time by Rustler
  def native_encode(_term, _type_id, _depth), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def native_decode(_type_id, _payload, _depth), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)

  @doc """
  Deserialize with type coercion - allows specifying expected output type.
  Uses native layer for efficient type conversion during deserialization.
  """
  def deserialize_as(binary, target_type, opts \\ []) when is_binary(binary) do
    caller = Keyword.get(opts, :caller, "anonymous")
    AuditLog.log_operation(:deserialize_as, %{
      caller: caller,
      size: byte_size(binary),
      target: target_type
    })

    with {:ok, type_id, payload} <- extract_header(binary),
         {:ok, coerced_payload} <- native_coerce(payload, type_id, resolve_type_id(target_type)),
         {:ok, term} <- decode_payload(resolve_type_id(target_type), coerced_payload, 0) do
      {:ok, term}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Batch deserialize with shared context - processes multiple serialized values
  using a shared native memory context for efficiency.
  """
  def batch_deserialize(binaries, opts \\ []) when is_list(binaries) do
    caller = Keyword.get(opts, :caller, "anonymous")
    AuditLog.log_operation(:batch_deserialize, %{caller: caller, count: length(binaries)})

    # Allocate shared native context
    {:ok, ctx} = native_alloc_context(length(binaries))

    results = binaries
    |> Enum.with_index()
    |> Enum.map(fn {binary, idx} ->
      with {:ok, type_id, payload} <- extract_header(binary),
           {:ok, term} <- native_decode_in_context(ctx, idx, type_id, payload) do
        {:ok, term}
      else
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, {idx, reason}}
      end
    end)

    # Context freed by GC via destructor - no explicit free needed
    {:ok, results}
  end

  def native_coerce(_payload, _from_type, _to_type), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def native_alloc_context(_size), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def native_decode_in_context(_ctx, _idx, _type_id, _payload), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)

  defp resolve_type_id(type) when is_binary(type), do: Map.get(@type_registry, type, 0)
  defp resolve_type_id(type) when is_atom(type), do: Map.get(@type_registry, Atom.to_string(type), 0)

  defp typeof(term) when is_binary(term), do: "binary"
  defp typeof(term) when is_integer(term), do: "integer"
  defp typeof(term) when is_float(term), do: "float"
  defp typeof(term) when is_list(term), do: "list"
  defp typeof(term) when is_map(term), do: "map"
  defp typeof(term) when is_atom(term), do: "atom"
  defp typeof(term) when is_tuple(term), do: "tuple"
  defp typeof(_), do: "unknown"
end
